app.title: MacType Control Center
files.subtitle: Choose, import, and save profiles for your font settings.
files.detectedDescription: The existing MacType installation contains the “{name}” profile. Continue to import a copy.
files.currentDescription: Manage the profile being edited and its unsaved changes in one place.
files.readOnly: This original file is read-only. Use Save as to keep your changes in a writable personal profile.
files.importDescription: Choose an INI on this computer and copy it into your personal profile folder without changing its contents.
files.duplicateDescription: Save the current settings under a new name in the app profile folder and switch to that file.
files.exportDescription: Save the settings being edited to a chosen location. The current profile and unsaved changes stay unchanged.
files.duplicated: Saved as {name} and switched the current profile.
files.applied: Applied {name} as the system-wide MacType profile.
files.selectDescription: Choose a profile, then apply it to use its font settings in apps.

overview.subtitle: Check whether MacType is running and see recent changes.

overview.nextDescription: Open an existing INI profile and review its settings. The original file remains unchanged until you save.
overview.logFolderFailed: Could not open the log folder.

wizard.startIntro: Adjust the core settings in order. Every change shows in the preview immediately, and the last step saves and applies.
wizard.startSwitchHint: To edit a different profile, choose it under Wizard > Profiles.
wizard.discardStepDescription: Discard only this step's unsaved changes.
wizard.unsavedWarning: The current preview values have not been saved to the profile yet.
wizard.savedState: The current values are saved in the profile.
wizard.guidance: Review each explanation and choose a value. Changes appear in the preview immediately.
profiles.readOnly: The original file cannot be written. Use Save as to create a writable personal profile.
profiles.saveBeforeApply: Save the changes before applying this profile.
profiles.savedAs: Saved as {path} and opened that profile.
profiles.resetDefaultsDescription: Restore the default settings. Keep per-font adjustments and lists. Save when you are ready to keep the changes.
profiles.addFontToList: Add a font to this list
profiles.listEntryPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
profiles.emptyIndividuals: There are no font-specific settings. Empty values inherit the profile defaults.

group.shape.label: Glyph shape

group.lcd.label: LCD and pixel layout
group.lcd.description: Reduce coloured edges and adjust text to suit your screen.
group.individual.label: Per-font settings
group.individual.description: Give individual fonts their own appearance settings.
group.lists.label: Include and exclude

execution.subtitle: Choose how MacType applies your font settings to apps.
execution.autostartTitle: Start in the tray at sign-in
execution.autostartDescription: Open Control Center in the tray when you sign in to Windows.
execution.autostartOn: Control Center will start in the tray when you sign in.
execution.manualDescription: Choose an app to open with MacType applied.
execution.browseFallback: Browse for an executable not in the list
execution.argumentsPlaceholder: Enter each required argument, such as a document path, on its own line
execution.systemDescription: Apply your profile to apps opened from now on. Restart apps that are already open to see the change.
execution.systemNote: Windows may ask for administrator approval when you change the service.
execution.systemActiveDescription: Your profile is being applied to newly opened apps.
execution.systemInactiveDescription: Reopen the target app in this state to compare rendering without the applied settings.
execution.systemInactiveNoProfileDescrip: No profile has been applied yet. Turning this on applies the bundled default profile (Default.ini) first.
execution.systemRunningUnverifiedTitle: Could not confirm that MacType is applying
execution.systemRunningUnverifiedDescrip: The service is running, but its effect on apps could not be checked. You can still stop it.
execution.systemProfileMismatchTitle: Service running with a different profile
execution.systemProfileMismatchDescripti: The service is using a different profile from the one selected here. You can stop it before applying your chosen profile.
execution.systemAppInitConflictDescripti: AppInit mode is also enabled. Turn it off in your previous MacType setup before changing this service. You can still stop the service.
execution.systemLegacyTrayConflictDescri: MacTray and this service are running together. Exit MacTray before changing the service. You can still stop the service.
execution.systemLegacyServiceMigrateTitl: A legacy MacTray service must be resolved first
execution.systemLegacyServiceMigrateDesc: An older MacTray service is installed. Use Migrate below to keep your profile and switch to the Control Center service.
execution.legacyServiceForeignTitle: A foreign legacy MacTray service was detected
execution.legacyServiceForeignDescriptio: A different service is using the MacType name. Check it in Windows Services before continuing.
execution.legacyServiceUncertainTitle: Legacy MacTray service status could not be verified
execution.legacyServiceUncertainDescript: The existing service could not be identified. Check its status in Windows Services, then refresh here.
execution.legacyTrayRunningDescription: MacTray running in this user session must exit before the new service can be used.
execution.legacyTrayOtherSessionTitle: MacTray is running in another user session
execution.legacyTrayOtherSessionDescript: MacTray is open under another Windows account. Close it from that account, then check again.
execution.legacyTrayUntrustedDescription: MacTray.exe is running from an unexpected location. Check it in Task Manager and close it yourself, then check again.
execution.legacyTrayUnknownTitle: MacTray tray mode status is unavailable
execution.legacyTrayUnknownDescription: Could not check whether MacTray is running. Check again before changing the service.
execution.legacyTrayAutostartDescription: Turn off MacTray startup so it does not run alongside this service at your next sign-in.
execution.legacyTrayAutostartUntrustedTi: A MacTray autostart entry could not be trusted
execution.legacyTrayAutostartUntrustedDe: The MacTray startup entry points to an unexpected location. Check it in Windows Startup apps or the Startup folder.
execution.legacyTrayAutostartUnknownDesc: Could not check MacTray startup. Check again before changing the service.
execution.legacyTrayExited: Requested a normal MacTray exit and checked the state again.
execution.legacyTrayAutostartDisabled: Disabled the verified MacTray autostart entry.
execution.systemUnavailableDescription: Wait for the current operation to finish, then refresh the status.
execution.systemPaused: MacType system application is temporarily off.
execution.systemActivated: The current profile is now applied system-wide.
execution.serviceRegistryConflict: AppInit registry mode is active, so service installation and startup are blocked.
execution.serviceForeign: A service with the same name has a different configuration. It will not be changed.
execution.serviceConfigurationDriftDescr: Service registration settings, such as the startup type, differ from the expected values. Repair or update the service to restore them.
execution.serviceStartedWithDefaultProfi: No profile was applied, so the default profile ({name}) was applied before starting the service.
execution.systemActivatedWithDefaultProf: No profile was applied, so the default profile ({name}) is now applied system-wide.
execution.servicePackageNotInstalledDesc: Run the installed Control Center. If you use the ZIP download, extract all its files together first.
execution.servicePackageIncompleteDescri: Required service files are missing. Reinstall Control Center or extract the complete ZIP again, keeping its folders together.
execution.servicePackageUntrustedDescrip: Some service files could not be verified. Reinstall Control Center or download and extract a fresh copy of the complete ZIP.
execution.openServiceControlDescription: This service applies your profile automatically when you open apps. You can start, stop, repair, or update it here.
execution.legacyServiceDescription: This is the old MacTray service. It can be removed separately after migration.
execution.migrationConfirmDescription: Control Center performs the migration in this order.
execution.migrationConfirmStrictCheck: Checks whether another MacType mode must be turned off first.
execution.migrationConfirmBackup: Backs up the current settings and profile before switching.
execution.migrationConfirmSwitch: Stops the legacy service, copies the current profile to the new service, then installs and starts it.
execution.migrationConfirmRollback: If migration fails, Control Center restores the services and profile to their previous state.
execution.migrationComplete: Migration to the new service completed.
execution.operationFailed: The operation failed. Check the diagnostics log for details.
execution.defaultProfileMissing: No profile is applied and the default profile (ini\Default.ini) was not found. Apply a profile on the Profiles page, then try again.
execution.defaultProfileInvalid: No profile is applied and the default profile (ini\Default.ini) could not be read. Apply a profile on the Profiles page, then try again.
execution.migrationFailed: Migration failed. Check the diagnostics log for details.
diagnostics.subtitle: Review the installation, component versions, and diagnostic logs.
diagnostics.logsDescription: Check recent problems to help find out what went wrong.
diagnostics.noHelperError: No preview errors have been recorded.
diagnostics.noOperationLogs: No operation failures have been recorded.
settings.hinting_mode.label: Hinting mode
settings.hinting_mode.description: Adjust how small letters stay sharp and retain their shape.
settings.enable_kerning.label: Kerning
settings.enable_kerning.description: Adjust spacing between letter pairs for more natural text.
settings.font_loader.label: Font loader
settings.font_loader.description: Choose how fonts are read. Try the other option if a font displays incorrectly.
settings.font_link.label: Font linking
settings.font_link.description: Use another font for characters missing from the chosen font.
settings.load_on_demand.label: Load on demand
settings.load_on_demand.description: Load fonts when they are first used instead of loading them in advance.
settings.direct_write.label: DirectWrite support
settings.direct_write.description: Apply font adjustments in supported DirectWrite apps. Check the result in the app; this preview does not show it.
settings.normal_weight.label: Normal weight
settings.normal_weight.description: Fine-tune the stroke weight of regular fonts.
settings.bold_weight.label: Bold weight
settings.bold_weight.description: Fine-tune the stroke weight of bold fonts.
settings.italic_slant.label: Italic slant
settings.italic_slant.description: Adjust the slant applied to italic fonts.
settings.bolder_mode.label: Emboldening mode
settings.bolder_mode.description: Choose the direction used to thicken strokes.
settings.gamma_mode.label: Gamma mode
settings.gamma_mode.description: Choose how the brightness of letter edges is adjusted.
settings.gamma_value.label: Gamma value
settings.gamma_value.description: Lower values make letter edges darker; higher values make them lighter.
settings.contrast.label: Contrast
settings.contrast.description: Adjust the contrast of rendered strokes.
settings.render_weight.label: Render weight
settings.render_weight.description: Adjust how heavy or light the text looks.
settings.anti_alias_mode.label: Antialiasing mode
settings.anti_alias_mode.description: Choose how letter edges are smoothed. Use grayscale if coloured edges are distracting.
settings.lcd_filter.label: LCD filter
settings.lcd_filter.description: Balance sharp text against coloured fringes on LCD screens.
settings.text_tuning.label: Grayscale tuning
settings.text_tuning.description: Adjust the strength of letter edges when using grayscale smoothing.
settings.text_tuning_r.label: Red-channel tuning
settings.text_tuning_r.description: Adjust the red component at letter edges.
settings.text_tuning_g.label: Green-channel tuning
settings.text_tuning_g.description: Adjust the green component at letter edges.
settings.text_tuning_b.label: Blue-channel tuning
settings.text_tuning_b.description: Adjust the blue component at letter edges.
settings.hint_small_font.label: Small-font hinting
settings.hint_small_font.description: Adjust small letters separately to help them stay readable.
settings.max_bitmap.label: Maximum bitmap font size
settings.max_bitmap.description: Use a font’s built-in pixel drawings up to this size. Set 0 for no size limit.
settings.max_height.label: Maximum rendering height
settings.max_height.description: Leave text taller than this unchanged by MacType. Set 0 for no upper limit.
settings.min_height.label: Minimum rendering height
settings.min_height.description: Leave text shorter than this unchanged by MacType.
execution.profileNotApplied: No profile has been applied yet
execution.registeredDescription: These apps open with MacType when launched at sign-in or from the tray menu.
execution.registered: Added the app to the tray launch list.
execution.removed: Removed the app from the tray launch list.
group.advanced.label: Advanced & experimental
group.advanced.description: Adjust app compatibility and memory use, or try experimental text options.
settings.use_mapping.label: Map font files
settings.use_mapping.description: Keep font data in memory using an alternative method. Try changing this if fonts fail to load.
settings.use_include.label: Use include lists
settings.use_include.description: Apply MacType only to apps selected in the application include list.
settings.font_substitutes.label: Font substitution
settings.font_substitutes.description: Replace fonts using your mappings. Safe mode limits replacement to reduce display problems; All replaces more fonts.
settings.cache_max_faces.label: Cached font faces
settings.cache_max_faces.description: Set how many fonts can be kept ready for reuse. Higher values may use more memory.
settings.cache_max_sizes.label: Cached font sizes
settings.cache_max_sizes.description: Set how many font sizes can be kept ready for reuse. Higher values may use more memory.
settings.cache_max_bytes.label: Cache memory
settings.cache_max_bytes.description: Limit the memory used to keep rendered letters for reuse.
settings.dw_gamma_value.label: DirectWrite gamma
settings.dw_gamma_value.description: Adjust the brightness of letter edges in DirectWrite apps.
settings.dw_contrast.label: DirectWrite contrast
settings.dw_contrast.description: Adjust how strongly letters stand out from the background in DirectWrite apps.
settings.dw_rendering_mode.label: DirectWrite rendering mode
settings.dw_rendering_mode.description: Choose how DirectWrite apps draw and smooth letters.
settings.dw_cleartype_level.label: DirectWrite ClearType level
settings.dw_cleartype_level.description: Adjust the amount of coloured edge smoothing in DirectWrite apps. Set 0 for grayscale.
settings.experimental_clip_box_fix.label: Clip-box fix
settings.experimental_clip_box_fix.descr: Try to prevent letter edges from being cut off in some apps.
settings.experimental_color_font.label: Color fonts
settings.experimental_color_font.descrip: Allow colour glyphs, such as supported emoji, to use their built-in colours.
settings.experimental_invert_color.label: Invert colors
settings.experimental_invert_color.descr: Adjust text rendering for inverted colours. This does not invert the whole screen.
advanced.shadowHelp: Adjust shadow position, opacity, and colour for light and dark backgrounds.
advanced.lcdWeightHelp: Fine-tune how smoothing spreads across letter edges. Compare the preview as you change each value.
advanced.pixelLayoutHelp: Match the positions of red, green, and blue dots on your screen. Keep the defaults if you do not know its layout.
advanced.fontSubstitutesHelp: Choose the source and replacement from installed fonts.
list.unloadDlls.label: Exclude apps by DLL
list.unloadDlls.help: Do not apply MacType to apps that load any DLL in this list.
list.excludeSubstitutionModules.label: Font-substitution exclusions
list.excludeSubstitutionModules.help: Keep the original fonts in these apps, even when font replacement is enabled.
